$comment: Stackra file contract: Purpose: the shape of an APP member's runway.yaml. Boundary: shape only; identity is stackra.config.ts, behaviour is src/config/*, accounts and zones are the root runway (runway/root.json). Runtime: node (editors and validators). Governing contract: ADR 0168 (runway.yaml schema), ADR 0170 (environments; no literal ports outside runway), ADR 0173 (secret names only), ADR 0175 (domains), ADR 0180 (EAS), ADR 0254 (desktop release), ADR 0146 (config layers), ADR 0231 (names).
title: runway.yaml (app member)
description: How and where one app runs, per environment: the dev port (the only place it is written), domains, public vars, secret names, release channels and Workers knobs (ADR 0168, 0170, 0173, 0254). A value here may override a root default, never the reverse.

$schema.description: The schema reference `stackra validate` reads (`@stackra/runway/schema/app.json`). Editors use the `# yaml-language-server: $schema=` comment instead.

health.description: The health endpoint the deploy gate calls (web and pwa targets; not desktop).

expects.description: What the endpoint must answer: the release SHA (ADR 0170 DP24).

pwa.description: PWA updates. The strategy is pwa.config.ts `updates`; this only adds the beta badge outside production.

channels.description: A subset of the root target's channels; `latest` is electron-updater's stable.

signing.description: Per-platform signing switch. Unsigned until a deliverable is named (ADR 0254 d1).

additionalProperties.description: Sign builds for this platform (mac, windows).

platforms.description: Installer formats per platform. Narrows desktop.config.ts packaging, never widens.

additionalProperties.description: Installer formats electron-builder produces for this platform.

mobile.description: EAS build and submit (ADR 0180). The OTA rollout and credentials are root `targets.eas`.

profiles.description: EAS build profiles. The update channel is the profile name.

androidApk.description: Build an APK instead of an AAB.

autoIncrement.description: Let EAS bump the build number.

environment.description: The EAS environment runway syncs vars into.

submit.description: Which stores the release job submits to. Root `targets.eas.submit` names the credentials.

telemetry.description: Telemetry destinations that are per member, not per environment.

sentryProject.description: Sentry project. The org is root `providers.sentry.org`; the DSN is a var.

environments.description: Per-environment values. Names are fixed (ADR 0170 DP5).

memberKey.description: The member key. Must equal stackra.config.ts `key`.

secretMap.description: Every @Secret of the env and config classes, by NAME. Values live in Infisical and runway syncs them on deploy (ADR 0173). A native client holds none (ADR 0206 d8).

additionalProperties.description: Options of one secret; `{}` takes the defaults.

secretList.description: The secret names this environment receives.

derived.description: A value gen derives instead of a literal, so a port is never repeated (ADR 0170).

from-port.description: Origin of a root dev infra service (lane offsets applied).

scheme.description: URL scheme to use instead of http.

vars.description: Values of the env class fields. gen checks the prefix: `VITE_` or `EXPO_PUBLIC_` for public values, `STACKRA_` for server values (ADR 0231). Never a secret.

additionalProperties.description: A literal, `ref:<path>`, `from-port`, or a derived value.

config.description: The last config layer (ADR 0146), keyed by config key.

port.description: A TCP port. Lanes add N × `portStep` per worktree.

environment.description: One environment of an app member.

port.description: Dev server port (web, pwa, the desktop renderer); HMR defaults to port + 1.

host.description: Dev host; `<key>.localhost` once root `dev.proxy` is on.

https.description: Serve the dev server over https.

open.description: Open a browser when the dev server starts.

domain.description: Public host in this environment; `${pr}` is expanded in previews.

destination.description: Override of root `destinations.web` for this member.

e2e.description: End-to-end settings: the base URL (`from-port`) and the seeds Playwright or Maestro use.

workers.description: Cloudflare Workers knobs: observability sampling and limits.

pwa.description: PWA update behaviour in this environment.

remoteDebugPort.description: Chrome remote debugging port in dev.

pkceLoopbackPort.description: Loopback port that takes the PKCE redirect in dev.

rollout.description: Override of the root staged rollout.

metroPort.description: Metro bundler port (the only place it is written).

devClient.description: Run with the Expo dev client.
